notes: Country: Germany, certainty high (EU plate 'L KD ...' = Leipzig, clinker plinth, roller shutters, slate hip roof). Calc profile DE, section [DE/DACH] + [INVARIANT].
Building: detached villa approx. 1920s (render with clinker quoins/accents), raised basement, 2 full storeys, hip roof with dormers. Historic door -> door anchors statistical.
Brick format: dark clinker, Reichsformat (~78 mm course) most likely, NF (83.3) candidate - coursing used at reliability low only.

Yaw: photo 1 approx. 5 deg (width correction 1/cos applied, negligible); photo 3 frontal; photo 6 frontal-ish with upward tilt (verticals corrected approx. +4 %); photos 2,4,5,8,9 steeply angled with ultra-wide distortion.
Depth basis: oblique_only - no photo shows a side elevation frontally (8 and 9 steep).
Occlusion: front approx. 45 % (tree, fence, cars), back approx. 35 % (people, bushes in lower zone), right approx. 40 % (annex, partial coverage), left approx. 25 %.
Datum: front grade at the entrance; site falls approx. 1300 mm to the garden (basement door of the bay at garden grade).
Chat run: values consolidated as weighted median of raw_estimates (weights per chat note), confidence from spread and capped by view angle; derived areas/perimeters/net areas computed.
Elevation interpretation: annex on the right (photos 2,7,8), garden bay at back-left set in approx. 790 from the left wall (photos 4,5,6), photo 9 = left wall looking towards the front.
